caveats.message: Advisory diagnostic: reported beside the ladder verdict, never read by a gate, a threshold or a pre-registration.

notes: Baseline rejection probability of IG_REALISTIC: 0.005; a skip level REPLACES it.

data.method: Every cell is a real engine run under a stressed copy of the run's own cost profile (sim/stress_profiles.py): broker rejects at the skip rate under several seeds, latency_bars for an entry delay, and every spread and slippage parameter scaled. Sizing prices the stressed costs too. Retention: median net profit over the baseline's.

boundary.detail: No holdout segment is defined for ['inmem:EURUSD:H4:2400'] yet, so the final 20% of the run's own bar span (from 2024-11-15T20:48:00+00:00) is treated as reserved: the fraction the ladder would reserve. Conservative when the run covers only part of its dataset.

source.detail: Robustness cache (written by the research worker), read-only.
